rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Outbound_HTTPS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects outbound Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS from internal hosts"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        tags = "C2, CobaltStrike, T1071.001"
    strings:
        $beacon_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $beacon_post = "POST / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 6.0; Windows NT 5.1; SV1)" ascii
    condition:
        all of them and net.conn.dst_port == 443 and net.conn.src_ip in (10.0.0.0/8)
}

arguments.summary: A critical ransomware incident was initiated through a phishing campaign targeting a finance user (CORP\jsmith) on endpoint WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42). The attack began with a malicious Outlook email triggering an encoded PowerShell command, which downloaded and executed a Cobalt Strike beacon (SHA256: a1b2c3d4...). The beacon established C2 communication with 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS, performed defense evasion via DLL injection, and attempted lateral movement. Although domain controller access (10.0.1.50) was targeted, no evidence confirms successful compromise. An unauthorized emergency lockdown directive referencing non-existent tool T8_iam_pam was detected and blocked, indicating potential insider threat or credential compromise. The malicious payload is confirmed as CobaltStrike.Beacon with keylogging, persistence, and C2 capabilities.
